name: ProofPay Verifiable Settlement Agent
description: Pay-on-acceptance settlement protocol using PayPal authorization holds (not escrow), deterministic schema & regex gates, verbatim quote-verified rubric extraction, adversarial injection scanning, and an append-only SHA-256 ledger.

schemes.description: Scoped organization user or agent API key created in /app/developers. Autonomous agent keys (is_agent=true) are blocked from money-approval and escalation endpoints.

mcp_tools.name: create_contract
mcp_tools.description: Compile a natural language specification into a formal ProofPay contract and apply safe lint fixes.

mcp_tools.name: accept_contract
mcp_tools.description: Accept proposed contract terms and lock the canonical SHA-256 contract hash.

mcp_tools.name: get_funding_link
mcp_tools.description: Generate a PayPal authorization approval URL for a human payer to approve manually.

mcp_tools.name: submit_deliverable
mcp_tools.description: Submit a JSON records or text deliverable for deterministic, quote-verified, and adversarial evaluation.

mcp_tools.name: get_verification_report
mcp_tools.description: Inspect deterministic checks, verbatim quotes, adversarial scan severity, and 8-rule policy output.

mcp_tools.name: get_contract_status
mcp_tools.description: Retrieve current contract state, authorization hold breakdown, and milestone capture status.
